sources.entry: re:Director - Simple domain redirection management tool. (Source Code) Apache-2.0 Java/Docker

summary.one_liner: A self-hosted redirect service for pointing domains or URLs at target destinations, with a web UI to manage them.
summary.what_it_does: re:Director lets you set up redirects by specifying a source domain and the target it should send visitors to. The web interface lets you create, filter (by source, target, or status), and pause redirects so they can be resumed later. You can choose the HTTP status code for each redirect: 301 Moved Permanently, 302 Found, 307 Temporary Redirect, or 308 Permanent Redirect. The README also lists path forwarding and query forwarding (added in v0.0.8 and v0.0.9), and a base URL setting (v0.0.11). The UI has a dark mode that follows system settings and a responsive layout for phones. Data is stored in a /data volume when run with Docker.
use_cases: Shorten long URLs into memorable addresses
Redirect an old domain to a new one
Temporarily pause a redirect and resume it later
Forward a domain while keeping paths and query strings
Manage redirects from a phone or browser
how_to_run: Clone the repo and make sure Java 27 is installed
Or pull the Docker image: docker run --name re-director -p 80:80 -v re-director-data:/data jensknipper/re-director:0.0.11
Or save the provided docker-compose.yml and run: docker-compose up
notable: Pause and resume redirects without deleting them
Choice of 301, 302, 307, and 308 redirect status codes
Docker image on Docker Hub with a compose file
caveats: Public-facing features such as authentication and automatic SSL are still on the roadmap and unchecked
Analytics and CSV import are not yet implemented
